projects.name: Itinera
projects.description: An AI-powered travel itinerary planner. Tell it where you are, where you want to go, your budget, and how long you've got — Gemini generates a day-by-day plan and you save it as a trip you can edit later. Next.js 15 + React 19 with Better Auth (email + Google OAuth), Prisma + PostgreSQL.

projects.name: AI NFT generator
projects.description: An AI-powered platform that creates unique, one-of-a-kind NFTs by generating custom art pieces based on user inputs, utilizing machine learning algorithms to craft digital collectibles.

projects.name: Chatapp
projects.description: A real-time chat application that connects users through seamless messaging and interactive features. With a sleek interface and advanced functionalities, it enhances communication for individuals and groups alike.

projects.name: Portfolio
projects.description: A portfolio website that showcases my projects, skills, and achievements in a clear layout. Built with Tailwind CSS for a responsive design, it highlights my work in software development.

projects.name: AI Meeting Booking Assistant
projects.description: An intelligent chatbot that schedules meetings via Cal.com. Built with FastAPI and LangChain, powered by Google Gemini 2.0 Flash — checks availability, creates bookings, resolves conflicts, and suggests alternative times.

projects.name: Rule Engine with AST
projects.description: A 3-tier rule engine that represents conditional rules as Abstract Syntax Trees so they can be composed, persisted, and evaluated dynamically against attribute data — without redeploying code. Django REST API, React + Vite frontend, PostgreSQL persistence, fully containerised with Docker Compose.
